messages.subject: Doubts about estimate
parts:
Hi, 

I am started in my studies about TRI and the package mirt a short time ago and i still have some difficults about. So my doubts are, how i enter with mean and variance specific(Mean = 500 and variance = 100) before estimate? And how i estimate just the parameter theta or the final value of hability, if i already have the value of parameter of difficulty, random and discrimination of the model 3PL for one hability? 

I am thank if get any help.

Thanks, anyway

On Mon, Aug 6, 2018 at 3:57 PM Edilson Freire Rodrigues Junior <edjju...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi, 

I am started in my studies about TRI and the package mirt a short time ago and i still have some difficults about. So my doubts are, how i enter with mean and variance specific(Mean = 500 and variance = 100) before estimate?
You could do this, but don't. It would cause very bad numerical issues. The default [0,1] constraint is probably what you want.
And how i estimate just the parameter theta or the final value of hability, if i already have the value of parameter of difficulty, random and discrimination of the model 3PL for one hability?

See the fscores() function. HTH.

Phil

I am thank if get any help.

Thanks, anyway
